name: build-toolchain-pins
body: Every toolchain that compiles or stages a frontend must be pinned in a repo-visible place and consumed by every build path that compiles a frontend: the CI release build (`.github/workflows/release.yml`'s `linux` job, which runs `cargo build --release` and drives `build.rs`, and its `bottle` job, which builds through the split Homebrew formulae) and those formulae themselves. The pin is exact where the toolchain mechanism or the closest build path can enforce it — Rust via a root `rust-toolchain.toml`, Node via `src/tslib/.npmrc engine-strict`, and Go on the release Linux path via `GOTOOLCHAIN` + `actions/setup-go`; where a path cannot enforce an exact version (Go on the bottle/ambient path, whose formula `depends_on 'go'` is unversioned), the requirement is a documented floor (`src/golib/go.mod`'s `toolchain` directive), not a floating latest. An unversioned, unfloored toolchain is a violation; a documented floor is not. JDK 21 (`actions/setup-java`) and .NET 10.0.x (`actions/setup-dotnet`) are the reference for an enforced pin. `install.sh` downloads prebuilt release tarballs and builds nothing, so it is not a pin consumer.
